blocks.text: With nearly 30 million Spotify streams and a No. 59 peak on the global chart, the rising artist is also set to headline his first solo concert. Filipino singer-songwriter SHEAN continues to make headlines as his debut single, “ako ang bagyo,” holds its No. 1 position on the Spotify Philippines charts for 10 consecutive days. To date, the song has amassed 30 million streams on the platform and reached a new peak of No. 59 on the Spotify Global charts dated November 7, 2026, with over 1.5 million streams in a single day.
